description: The STELIB empirical stellar library: 255 stars observed 3200-9500 A (cited window) at ~3 A FWHM, 1 A sampling, absolute spectrophotometry (3% overall uncertainty), published as the VizieR catalog III/232 (Le Borgne et al. 2003). One stellarlib product mirrors the whole catalog tree: ReadMe, the star table table.dat, the corrected spectra cor_sp/ (interstellar-extinction and radial-velocity corrected — the published library), their raw counterparts obs_sp/, and the published atlas stelib.ps.gz.
license: no license statement in the catalog tree (2026-11-18); research use with the reference cited
channel_notes: CDS is the canonical source; the NAOJ ADAC mirror (vizier.nao.ac.jp) serves the identical native tree over plain HTTP. The blueprint entry picks the channel explicitly (source="cds" (default) | "adac"); there is no fallback between channels, and each part's manifest entry records the URL it was actually fetched from.

tree.cor_sp: 255 FITS files, exactly the table's cSpFile1/cSpFile2 names (254 rows list a cSpFile1, one row lists a cSpFile2 second spectrum, one row — LHS 235 — lists none)
tree.obs_sp: 258 FITS files, exactly the table's oSpFile1/oSpFile2 names (254 + 4, no duplicates, no strays)

verified.fits_format: every file sampled (all 255 cor, all 258 obs): NAXIS=1, NAXIS1=6700, BITPIX=-32, BUNIT 'erg /s /cm2 /angstroms', linear WCS CTYPE1='LINEAR' with per-star CRVAL1 (~3196-3200) and CDELT1 (~0.999) — every star sits on its own grid
verified.cds_channel: not verified from the 2026-11-18 build site: its egress cannot reach cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr at all (proxy CONNECT timeout, 7th recurrence); the https url template is the documented form of the ftp tree — verify from a machine with direct CDS access before relying on it

format_notes: one FITS per spectrum: 1-D image (NAXIS=1, 6700 float32 pixels), BUNIT 'erg /s /cm2 /angstroms'; the wavelength axis is the header's own linear WCS (CRPIX1=1, per-star CRVAL1/CDELT1), pixel domain ~3196-9898 A while the paper cites 3200-9500 A — both are the upstream's own statements, recorded, never adjusted

cor_sp files end _V<version>.fits (V3.2 across the tree) and carry ISEXTINC (applied Av), RADVEL, and a HISTORY card stating the extinction correction; obs_sp files end _moy.fits (per-run mean) and are the raw counterparts — held and mirrored, not the served library

table.dat is fixed-width ASCII with the layout the ReadMe documents byte by byte (star 1-10, Teff 48-52, log g 54-57, [Fe/H] 59-63, cSpFile1 124-143, oSpFile1 145-165, cSpFile2 167-186, oSpFile2 188-208); '-' marks a value the table does not report; lines run 186-208 bytes (trailing empty columns are simply absent)

the FITS headers carry EQUINOX B1950.0 while the table's coordinates are documented J2000.0, and card APNUM1 is non-standard (astropy warns) — quirks of the published files, preserved verbatim and recorded, never fixed

the ReadMe states the fluxes in 10mW/m2/nm (erg/cm2/s/A): the library is absolute spectrophotometry at the observer, not a model surface flux — mapped to observed_flux_density, never onto eddington_flux/surface_flux

references.citation: Le Borgne, J.-F., et al. 2003, A&A 402, 433 (the STELIB library)
